note: Places with a story (src/systems/landmarks.gd): the hermit Absalom Fenn. Notes and journal pages are in the script. Original writing.

lines.speaker: fenn
lines.line: Mind the beans. They're the only company I keep that doesn't talk back.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Only passing. You've been up here a while.

lines.speaker: fenn
lines.line: Since before the railroad. Before the syndicate. Before most of the names on your map.

lines.speaker: fenn
lines.line: I was a surveyor. Drew the lines they're fighting over now. Then I saw what lines are for, and I came up here to stop drawing them.

lines.speaker: fenn
lines.line: Take my last field book. There's a spring in it nobody's sold yet. Keep it that way.
